instruction: The native Altium schematic file `C:\Users\user\Desktop\oscillator_core.SchDoc` is the initial design. Add the user parameter `Tolerance` only to the 4 resistor components below, then save the modified native document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\oscillator_tolerance.SchDoc`. Requirements: - `R42` must have `Tolerance=1%`. - `R33`, `R39`, and `R34` must each have `Tolerance=5%`. - `V24`, `C1`, `Q16`, `C3`, and `L1` must not gain a `Tolerance` parameter. - Do not change any existing designator, Value, Comment, or other existing information. [Software] To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).
